1.title: Madonna pays tribute to 'genius, otherworldly' producer William Orbit
1.summary: The Queen of Pop worked with Orbit several times over the years, most notably on her genre-bending, Grammy Award-winning album Ray of Light.

2.title: Outbreak of Vibrio Vulnificus, a Flesh-Eating Bacteria, Kills 5 in Louisiana
2.summary: Vibrio vulnificus, which thrives in warm, brackish water, has also killed two people in Florida this year.

3.title: The U.S. Is Burning Through Weapons in Iran. Russia and China Are Taking Note.
3.summary: The Iran war has depleted U.S. weapons stockpiles, resulting in a significant erosion of firepower. A more drawn-out Iran conflict benefits Moscow and Beijing, some analysts say.

4.title: Fast-moving Canada wildfire doubles in size forcing thousands to flee homes
4.summary: The Bald Range wildfire in British Columbia, still considered "out of control", has spread to more than 36 sq miles (95 sq km).

5.title: Child among three killed in Russian missile attacks near Kyiv
5.summary: Russia continued its overnight attacks after President Volodymyr Zelensky warned of Ukraine's dwindling supplies of missile interceptors.

6.title: US offers $1bn to Colombia on new right-wing president's first day of office
6.summary: Abelardo de la Espriella used his maiden speech to promise an "all-out war" on what he calls "narco-terrorism".
